clean_steps.name: sales_only
clean_steps.rule: Keep the Sales group only (mortgages and gifts are separate groups).

clean_steps.name: sale_procedures
clean_steps.rule: Keep the four sale procedures (Sale, Sell - Pre registration, Delayed Sell, Sale On Payment Plan). Drop lease-to-own contracts, development registrations and land additions, which are not market sales.

clean_steps.name: exact_duplicates
clean_steps.rule: Drop rows that repeat another row exactly (same page served twice).

clean_steps.name: residential_flat_villa
clean_steps.rule: Keep residential flats and villas only. Drop land, offices, shops, hotel apartments, hotel rooms and whole buildings.

clean_steps.name: missing_value_or_area
clean_steps.rule: Drop rows with a missing or zero price or a missing or zero built-up area (procedure area stands in when built-up area is missing, as in the bulk file).

clean_steps.name: bulk_deals
clean_steps.rule: Drop bulk deals: rows that share a transaction number carry the whole portfolio price on every unit.

clean_steps.name: area_bounds
clean_steps.rule: Keep flats of 20 to 1000 sqm and villas of 50 to 3000 sqm.

clean_steps.name: price_per_sqm_bounds
clean_steps.rule: Keep 3,000 to 120,000 AED per sqm. Below that are nominal transfers and data errors; above it are portfolio deals recorded against one unit.
